description: This file provides a comprehensive API client for interacting with QQ's bot platform, including token management, message sending (text, media, group, direct), media uploads, and background token refresh mechanisms.

methods.name: onMessageSent
methods.description: Registers a callback hook for outbound messages scoped to a specific appId.

methods.name: initApiConfig
methods.description: Initializes per-app API behavior such as markdown support.

methods.name: isMarkdownSupport
methods.description: Checks if markdown is supported for a given appId.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token with caching and singleflight semantics.

methods.name: clearTokenCache
methods.description: Clears token cache for a specific appId or all caches.

methods.name: getTokenStatus
methods.description: Provides diagnostic status of token cache for a given appId.

methods.name: getNextMsgSeq
methods.description: Generates a message sequence number in the 0..65535 range.

methods.name: apiRequest
methods.description: Performs a shared API request with error handling and logging.

methods.name: apiRequestWithRetry
methods.description: Performs an API request with exponential backoff retries for transient errors.

methods.name: getGatewayUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway URL for real-time messaging.

methods.name: sendC2CMessage
methods.description: Sends a customer-to-customer message.

methods.name: sendC2CInputNotify
methods.description: Sends an input notification message to a user.

methods.name: sendChannelMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific channel.

methods.name: sendDmMessage
methods.description: Sends a direct message inside a guild DM session.

methods.name: sendGroupMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a group.

methods.name: sendProactiveC2CMessage
methods.description: Sends a proactive customer-to-customer message.

methods.name: sendProactiveGroupMessage
methods.description: Sends a proactive group message.

methods.name: uploadC2CMedia
methods.description: Uploads media for C2C messages, with caching.

methods.name: uploadGroupMedia
methods.description: Uploads media for group messages, with caching.

methods.name: sendC2CMediaMessage
methods.description: Sends a media message to a user.

methods.name: sendGroupMediaMessage
methods.description: Sends a media message to a group.

methods.name: sendC2CImageMessage
methods.description: Uploads and sends an image message to a user, supporting base64 and URL sources.

methods.name: sendGroupImageMessage
methods.description: Uploads and sends an image message to a group.

methods.name: sendC2CVoiceMessage
methods.description: Uploads and sends a voice message to a user.

methods.name: sendGroupVoiceMessage
methods.description: Uploads and sends a voice message to a group.

methods.name: sendC2CFileMessage
methods.description: Uploads and sends a file message to a user.

methods.name: sendGroupFileMessage
methods.description: Uploads and sends a file message to a group.

methods.name: sendC2CVideoMessage
methods.description: Uploads and sends a video message to a user.

methods.name: sendGroupVideoMessage
methods.description: Uploads and sends a video message to a group.

methods.name: startBackgroundTokenRefresh
methods.description: Starts a background process to refresh tokens periodically for an appId.

methods.name: stopBackgroundTokenRefresh
methods.description: Stops background token refresh for a specific appId or all.

methods.name: isBackgroundTokenRefreshRunning
methods.description: Checks if background token refresh is active for an appId or any.
